'''2010 Worlds Day 2 PMJ LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[PMJ]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: RS Approved WYS. Transcription note: sheet Name "PMJ" (initials only)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
